legacy_payload.best_for: 以近黑中性底、1px 发丝线网格与单一紫蓝强调的精密工程感,做开发者工具与技术产品发布;Inter Tight 大标题 × JetBrains Mono 标签的极致克制
legacy_payload.visual_direction: dark hairline engineering aesthetic, near-black neutral canvas (not blue-dark) with 1px hairline grid lattice, single violet-blue accent, large tight sans headlines with monospace labels and data, extreme whitespace, Linear-Vercel dev-tool precision, subtle border highlights instead of glows

canvas.background: 近黑中性底 #0D0D0F(非纯黑非深蓝;避开 GitHub-dark 深蓝底(0D1117)禁区)
canvas.composition: 极简标题页一句话 + mono 小标;hairline 分隔的数据网格;mono 标签特性列表
canvas.density: low-to-medium,极致留白——信息少而精密

color_palette.rule: 1px 发丝线 #262629 承担全部结构;紫蓝强调只进关键状态/数字/单选高亮;微光用极淡 border highlight 而非 glow;禁均匀深蓝底+青紫霓虹

typography.title: Inter Tight / 思源黑体 大标题,紧字距
typography.labels: JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono 单等宽标签:数据、状态、路径

layout_patterns: 标题页 = 近黑底一句话标题 + mono 小标(如版本号/日期),余皆空
数据页 = hairline 网格分隔的指标矩阵(线表,非卡片)
特性页 = mono 标签(01/02/03)+ 特性名 + 一行说明的纵列
对比页 = 双栏 hairline 中缝分隔,强调色只标胜出项
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 线表胜过卡片:结构全交给 1px 发丝线;每页信息量克制,mono 标签做导航与计量
negative_prompt: no uniform deep-blue GitHub-dark canvas (0D1117-style) with cyan-purple neon glow — banned lazy combo
no heavy cards or drop shadows; hairline borders carry the structure
no saturated rainbow accents; one violet-blue accent only
no pure black #000000; the canvas stays neutral near-black with visible hairlines

visual_elements.allowed: 1px 发丝线网格,mono 标签,近白大标题,单强调色高亮,极淡 border highlight
visual_elements.avoid: 深蓝底霓虹 glow;重卡片;多彩强调;纯黑无层次底

rendering_constraints: Near-black neutral canvas; hairline #262629 lattice for structure.
Subtle border highlights replace glow effects.
